about_the_game:
🎮Vietnam Warrior: Against the US Invasion is a pixel-art action game that recreates the Vietnamese people's resistance war against the US through the lens of a guerrilla fighter. The game is not only entertaining but also an emotional historical journey, taking players back to the Vietnam War period with fierce battles, guerrilla tactics, and the indomitable spirit of the nation.

🧭 Historical setting

The game is inspired by the Vietnam War (1955–1975), especially the peak of the resistance against the US invasion. Players take on the role of a soldier of the Southern Liberation Army, fighting in jungles, tunnels, and fierce battlefields such as Truong Son, Khe Sanh, Hue, and Saigon.

🔫 Gameplay

Genre: 2D action, side-scrolling shooter, combining tactical elements.

Mode: Single-player story-driven, with the option to expand survival or co-op mode.

Weapons & Equipment: AK guns, B40s, mines, tunnels, and guerrilla combat tools.

Environment: Tropical jungles, villages, US military bases, Cu Chi tunnels.

Historical interaction: Players will participate in famous battles such as Tet Mau Than 1968, Ho Chi Minh Campaign 1975, and can meet historical figures such as General Vo Nguyen Giap or Uncle Ho through dialogues or special missions.

🏆 Highlights

Nostalgic pixel art: Reminiscent of retro games but with deep content.

Battlefield sounds: Helicopter sounds, artillery fire, and revolutionary music create a realistic atmosphere.

Patriotic message: Honoring the fighting spirit, courage, and sacrifice of our ancestors. Nguyen Duc Anh

content_descriptors.notes: Vietnam Warrior: Against the US Invasion contains cartoon violence, blood, corpses, and killing. Players engage in combat using weapons, and characters may be injured or killed during gameplay. The game does not include sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, self-harm, or sensitive themes such as non-consensual sex, BDSM, or physical/mental abuse.

  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB or Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. Attention: In this game you will encounter a variety of visual effects that may provide seizures or loss of consciousness in a minority of people. If you or someone you know experiences any of the above symptoms while playing, stop and seek medical attention immediately.
